evidence: bare_number_card: seg0:start to seg1:end: '900' and '27.6K' are just big numbers beside faint baselines. Nothing shows the 30x gap, so the 27.6K line is no longer than the 900 line.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg1:start, seg1:mid and seg1:end are the same frame as the hook: '900' and '27.6K' in text on two thin baselines with an idle mascot on each. The 30x speed gap is never drawn, and the layout sits unchanged for about 18 seconds.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The speed comparison is set as two labelled numbers instead of a machine where speed becomes motion, so no geometry carries the ratio. Reusing the same layout from the hook to the end of seg1 makes it a long static hold.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show speed as motion: a jet and the ISS crossing the same stretch, where the ISS covers ~30 of the jet's lengths (or laps a globe) while the jet barely moves. Have Data chase or ride the ISS and fall behind, and cut away before 6s so the hook shows something different.
